fn ov_resources_check(stage:*OvStage)->bool {
    if !ov_resources_prepare(stage) { return false; }
    return rs_prepare((*(*stage).hooks).user as *RsStage);
}

// Require an empty initialized context and retained source storage.
// Complete overload selection, ownership checking, cleanup, and the requested output.
fn overload_resource_program(request:*RmdBuild)->i32 {
    var context:*RmdContext = (*request).context;
    var cli:CCli = uninit;
    var success:bool = c_driver_init(&cli, context, (*request).argc);
    cli.root = (*request).source;
    cli.target_begin = (*request).target_begin;
    var resources:RsStage = uninit;
    rs_init(&resources, context);
    var hooks:OvHooks = uninit;
    var overloads:OvStage = uninit;
    ov_resources_init(&overloads, &resources, "resources_x64_v1", &hooks);
    var result:i32 = 1i32;
    if success && c_driver_parse(&cli, (*request).argc, (*request).argv, 0i32) {
        result = ov_driver_build(&cli, &overloads, ov_resources_read, ov_resources_check,
            rs_c_body, &resources as *u8);
    }
    c_stage_destroy(&cli.stage);
    return result;
}

// Compile the retained source from begin through EOF, print failures, and release its context.
fn overload_resource_build(source:*RmdSource, begin:usize, argc:i32, argv:**u8)->i32 {
    var context:RmdContext = uninit;
    rmd_context_init(&context, null(*RmdAllocator));
    var request:RmdBuild = make RmdBuild {
        context:&context, source:source, target_begin:begin, argc:argc, argv:argv
    };
    var result:i32 = overload_resource_program(&request);
    if context.error_count != 0usize { c_driver_diagnostic(&context); }
    rmd_context_destroy(&context);
    return result;
}
